hints.title: Deep Structural Delta Comparison
hints.text: Comparing two dictionary representations produces a diff structure retaining only paths where values diverge, representing differences as two-element arrays.

hints.title: Type Mismatch and Array Object Distinction
hints.text: If types differ, or if one is array while the other is plain object, record [obj1, obj2]. If both are primitive and equal, omit. If both are objects/arrays of matching kind, recurse on shared keys.

hints.title: Diff Traversal Blueprint
hints.text: If o1 === o2 return {}. If either is null or not object return [o1, o2]. If array status of o1 does not match o2, return [o1, o2]. Build diff object: for each key in o1: if key in o2, subDiff = objDiff(o1[key], o2[key]); if Object.keys(subDiff).length > 0 diff[key] = subDiff. Return diff.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total elements/keys across both structures
complexity.notes: Visits shared keys once, building differential objects only on branches containing changes.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Superficial comparison ignores nested object modifications or mistakenly treats array/object mismatches as identical structures.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Omits unchanged branches, resulting in sparse output memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly ignoring non-shared keys and distinguishing between arrays and plain objects.

solutions.approach: Recursive Structural Difference with Two-Element Tuple Extraction
